{{alias}}( x, alpha )
    Adds a scalar constant to each element in an ndarray.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    alpha: number
        Scalar constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0 ];
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/ctor}}( 'generic', xbuf, [ 4 ], [ 1 ], 0, 'row-major' );
    > {{alias}}( x, 5.0 )
    <ndarray>
    > x.data
    [ 6.0, 7.0, 8.0, 9.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
